name: textract_ocr_tool
description: Run Amazon Textract OCR on one selected, already-rendered PDF page. Produces a schema-compatible BADGERS spine and quality score. Escalate the same page to Vision only when quality_passed is false.

image_path.description: S3 URI of the selected rendered page image.

source_document_path.description: S3 URI of the original PDF.

result.description: JSON result with quality_passed, ocr_output_uri, canonical_output_uri, and escalation decision.
